simple.meaning: אֲסֻפָּה (ʼăçuppâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural)
definitions.full: H627. asuppah [ אֲסֻמָּה ] noun feminine collection (compare Phoenician אספת assembly ) only אֲסֻמּוֺת בַּעֲלֵי Eccl 12:11 ( חֲכָמִים דִּבְרֵי ) compared to driven nails; members of learned assemblies Thes MV and others; so Post-Biblical Hebrew NHWB i. 127 ; but Hi-Now and others refer to the wise utterances, called lords (possessors) of collection because of their well-connected grouping.
